intent_en: To demonstrate that police reform proposals enjoy substantial support among Republicans and white Americans, even though Democrats and black Americans exhibit higher levels of favorability and intensity.
previous_intent: To compare support for police reform proposals across political and racial demographics, highlighting that while Democrats and Black Americans favor them more strongly, Republicans and White Americans also demonstrate substantial backing.
narration_support: black Americans and Democrats are more likely to support these things and the intensity of support is higher. There is a fair amount of support among white Americans and Republicans for all of these things as well.
chart_support: A horizontal stacked bar chart showing the proportion of Republicans/Republican leaners who strongly or somewhat favor various police reform proposals, indicating broad overall favorability across the measures.
evidence_note: The narration establishes a comparison where Democrats and black Americans lead in support, but emphasizes significant Republican/white support. The chart visualizes the Republican side of this comparison, showing high total support (strongly + somewhat) for all listed proposals, which aligns with the narration's claim of a 'fair amount of support'.
